name: Vaultwarden
description: Lightweight server compatible with the Bitwarden password manager apps and browser extensions. Vault data is encrypted on your devices; the server stores only ciphertext.
maintainer: Daniel García and Mathijs van Veluw (BlackDex)

volumes.name: data
volumes.description: Encrypted vaults (SQLite), attachments, keys. Must be a Docker volume: SQLite over a Windows folder is unreliable.

inputs.label: Allow creating accounts
inputs.help: Needed to create your own account. Turn it off afterwards (SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false in .env, then restart) and invite others instead.

security: The web vault needs HTTPS (or http://127.0.0.1 on this PC) because browsers allow its cryptography only in a secure context.
The /admin page is disabled (no ADMIN_TOKEN). Enable it only with an Argon2 hash (docker compose exec app /vaultwarden hash) and never publish /admin.
Back up the data volume: losing it loses every vault on this server.
The manager never reads vault contents; backups copy the encrypted database as it is.

notes: Bitwarden apps, browser extensions and the CLI call /api and /identity directly: ForwardAuth and Cloudflare Access break them. Publish it, if at all, without a sign-in gate; it has its own login and end-to-end encryption.
OpenID Connect sign-in (SSO_* settings, e.g. with authentik) is supported since 1.35; the master password stays required.

limitations: Over plain http on a LAN address or hostname, the web vault refuses to sign in; use http://127.0.0.1 locally or publish it with HTTPS.
Bitwarden clients need version 2026.7.0 or later for Vaultwarden 1.37.
manualSetup: Open it and create your account (signups are on), then set SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false in .env and restart.
Optional: set up SMTP for invitations and the admin page with an Argon2 ADMIN_TOKEN.

update.notes: Read the release notes: minimum client versions change. The database migrates on start; the update backs it up first.

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation: health, own API, network isolation, modular stack, stop/start, Traefik file route, backup and restore, removal with data.
